Building with Character

WE TREAT OUR CLIENTS EXCELLENTLY.

Since 2018, Wheatland Construction has been building with character. As a family-owned company, we take pride in our quality craftsmanship, building custom homes, additions and remodels with integrity and excellence.

Why Choose Wheatland?

Personal, Hands-On Service

As a family-owned company, we are a true partner in your project — working closely with you from start to finish, making the process smooth, transparent, and stress-free.

Decades of Experience

Satisfied Clients

A MODERN APPROACH

Our Process

1

Consultation

We begin by reviewing your ideas, existing plans, or needed drawings and discuss your goals and budget. Let’s outline the next steps to bring your project to life!

2

Contracting

Once the scope is clear, we present a detailed proposal and offer flexible pricing options — whether you prefer a cost-plus or hard bid arrangement — to fit your needs and budget.

3

Pre-Construction

Let’s finalize the details — selecting materials, refining the schedule, etc. This step ensures clarity and confidence before we break ground. Measure twice, cut once!

4

Construction

Our dedicated staff are involved throughout the construction process. We communicate well with you throughout, ensuring your vision is executed to your expectations.

5

Completion

Our job isn’t done until everything meets our high standards — and yours. When the project is complete, we hope we’ve turned you into a true fan. We finish by praying for peace and joy in your new or updated home for years to come!

★★★★★

“Wheatland Construction built a new deck on the back of my house last fall. The one I had was rickety and needed to be completely replaced. I wanted a new one, same size and shape as the old one. Wheatland took out all the support pieces and even replaced two posts that supported part of my porch roof. The new deck is amazing! The whole rebuilding took about four weeks, but Wheatland’s carpenter, James, and project manager, Carl, communicated with me every step of the way. Jonathan came by two or three times to check with me and ask me how things were going. Some delays were weather-related, and some were because the concrete needed to cure. In one case, some of the boards were not up to Wheatland’s standards and had to be replaced by the lumber company. I am very happy with my new deck, and I recommend Wheatland Construction for any home project.”
